```json
        "originalContents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { SocialProfile, PortfolioItem, SocialPost, SkillEndorsement } from '../../types/Social';\nimport './ProfileView.scss';\n\nconst ProfileView: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { userId } = useParams\u003c{ userId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [profile, setProfile] = useState\u003cSocialProfile | null\u003e(null);\n  const [posts, setPosts] = useState\u003cSocialPost[]\u003e([]);\n  const [endorsements, setEndorsements] = useState\u003cSkillEndorsement[]\u003e([]);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'posts' | 'portfolio' | 'skills' | 'connections'\u003e('posts');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isFollowing, setIsFollowing] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadProfileData();\n  }, [userId]);",

        "contents": ".social-dashboard {\n  min-height: 100vh;\n  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f7fa 0%, #c3cfe2 100%);\n  padding: 20px;\n\n  .dashboard-header {\n    background: white;\n    border-radius: 16px;\n    padding: 24px;\n    margin-bottom: 24px;\n    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n    display: flex;\n    justify-content: space-between;\n    align-items: center;\n\n    h1 {\n      font-size: 28px;\n      font-weight: 700;\n      color: #1f2937;\n      margin: 0;\n    }\n\n    .header-actions {\n      display: flex;\n      align-items: center;\n      gap: 20px;\n\n      .stats {\n        display: flex;\n        gap: 16px;\n        font-size: 14px;\n        color: #6b7280;\n\n        span {\n          padding: 4px 12px;\n          background: #f3f4f6;\n          border-radius: 20px;\n          font-weight: 500;\n        }\n\n        .requests-badge {\n          background: #fef3c7;\n          color: #d97706;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  .tabs {\n    background: white;\n    border-radius: 16px;\n    padding: 12px;\n    margin-bottom: 24px;\n    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n    display: flex;\n    gap: 8px;\n    flex-wrap: wrap;\n    justify-content: center;\n\n    .tab {\n      padding: 12px 20px;\n      border: none;\n      background: transparent;\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      font-size: 14px;\n      font-weight: 500;\n      color: #6b7280;\n      cursor: pointer;\n      transition: all 0.2s ease;\n      white-space: nowrap;\n      min-width: 120px;\n      text-align: center;\n\n      \u0026:hover {\n        background: #f3f4f6;\n        color: #374151;\n      }\n\n      \u0026.active {\n        background: #3b82f6;\n        color: white;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n",
```

```json
        "contents": "\n\nconst MemberCard: React.FC\u003cMemberCardProps\u003e = ({ \n  profile, \n  index = 0, \n  isFiltering = false,\n  currentUserId,\n  className = ''\n}) =\u003e {\n  const [user] = useAuthState(auth);\n  const [isBookmarked, setIsBookmarked] = useState(false);\n  const [isBookmarking, setIsBookmarking] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleBookmark = async (e: React.MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    e.stopPropagation();\n    \n    if (!user?.uid || !currentUserId) return;\n    \n    setIsBookmarking(true);\n    try {\n      const userRef = doc(db, 'users', currentUserId);\n      const profileId = 'uid' in profile ? profile.uid : profile.id;\n      \n      if (isBookmarked) {\n        await updateDoc(userRef, {\n          bookmarkedUsers: arrayRemove(profileId)\n        });\n        setIsBookmarked(false);\n      } else {\n        await updateDoc(userRef, {\n          bookmarkedUsers: arrayUnion(profileId)\n        });\n        setIsBookmarked(true);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error updating bookmark:', error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsBookmarking(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getAvailabilityColor = (availability?: string) =\u003e {\n    if (!availability) return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    \n    switch (availability.toLowerCase()) {\n      case 'available':\n        return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800';\n      case 'soon':\n        return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800';\n      case 'unavailable':\n        return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800';\n      default:\n        return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get primary job title\n  const primaryJobTitle = isCrewProfile(profile)\n    ? profile.jobTitles?.[0]?.title || 'Crew Member'\n    : profile.jobTitle || 'Crew Member';\n\n  // Get primary location\n  let primaryLocation = 'Location not specified';",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { collection, query, where, orderBy, getDocs, onSnapshot } from 'firebase/firestore';\nimport { db } from '../../firebase';\nimport { FollowRequest, SocialNotification, ActivityFeedItem, Follow } from '../../types/Social';\nimport { CrewProfile } from '../../types/CrewProfile';\nimport { SocialService } from '../../utilities/socialService';\nimport { UserUtils, UserProfile } from '../../utilities/userUtils';\nimport QuickMessage from './QuickMessage';\nimport FollowButton from './FollowButton';\nimport ActivityFeed from './ActivityFeed';\nimport ChatInterface from '../Chat/ChatInterface';\nimport { SocialAnalytics } from './SocialAnalytics';\nimport { AdvancedMessaging } from './AdvancedMessaging';\nimport NotificationBell from './NotificationBell';\nimport { performanceMonitor } from '../../utilities/performanceUtils';\nimport './SocialDashboard.scss';\nimport { toast } from 'react-hot-toast';\nimport { Unsubscribe } from 'firebase/auth';\n\ninterface SocialDashboardProps {\n  currentUserId: string;\n  currentUserName: string;\n  currentUserAvatar?: string;\n}",
        "detailedLines": [

            "lineNumber": 1,

        "contents": "          .member-card {\n            background: white;\n            border-radius: 16px;\n            padding: 20px;\n            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n            transition: all 0.3s ease;\n            position: relative;\n\n            \u0026:hover {\n              box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n              transform: translateY(-2px);\n            }\n\n            .member-avatar {\n              position: relative;\n              margin-bottom: 16px;\n\n              img {\n                width: 60px;\n                height: 60px;\n                border-radius: 50%;\n                object-fit: cover;\n                border: 3px solid #e5e7eb;\n              }\n\n              .bookmark-btn {\n                position: absolute;\n                top: -5px;\n                right: -5px;\n                background: white;\n                border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n                border-radius: 50%;\n                width: 30px;\n                height: 30px;\n                display: flex;\n                align-items: center;\n                justify-content: center;\n                cursor: pointer;\n                transition: all 0.2s ease;\n                font-size: 14px;\n\n                \u0026:hover {\n                  background: #f3f4f6;\n                  transform: scale(1.1);\n                }\n              }\n            }\n\n            .member-info {\n              margin-bottom: 16px;\n\n              h4 {\n                font-size: 16px;\n                font-weight: 600;\n                color: #1f2937;\n                margin: 0 0 4px 0;\n              }\n\n              .member-title {\n                font-size: 14px;\n                color: #6b7280;\n                margin: 0 0 4px 0;\n              }\n\n              .member-location {\n                font-size: 13px;\n                color: #9ca3af;\n                margin: 0;\n              }\n            }\n\n",

        "contents": "\n\nconst MembersList: React.FC\u003cMembersListProps\u003e = ({\n  members,\n  title,\n  variant = 'default',\n  emptyMessage = 'No members to display',\n  className = '',\n  currentUserId,\n  isFiltering = false,\n}) =\u003e {\n  // Get card classes based on variant\n  const getCardClasses = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'h-24';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'h-96';\n      default:\n        return 'h-64';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get grid columns based on variant\n  const getGridColumns = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3';\n      default:\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get gap size based on variant\n  const getGap = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'gap-3';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'gap-6';\n      default:\n        return 'gap-4';\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className={cn('w-full', className)}\u003e\n      {title \u0026\u0026 (\n        \u003ch2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\"\u003e{title}\u003c/h2\u003e\n      )}\n      \n      {members.length === 0 ? (\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-500\"\u003e{emptyMessage}\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cdiv className={cn('grid', getGridColumns(), getGap())}\u003e\n          {members.map((member, index) =\u003e (\n            \u003cMemberCard\n              key={member.id}\n              profile={member}\n              index={index}\n              isFiltering={isFiltering}\n              currentUserId={currentUserId}\n              className={getCardClasses()}\n            /\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst MembersList: React.FC\u003cMembersListProps\u003e = ({\n  members,\n  title,\n  variant = 'default',\n  emptyMessage = 'No members to display',\n  className = '',\n  currentUserId,\n  isFiltering = false,\n}) =\u003e {\n  // Get card classes based on variant\n  const getCardClasses = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'h-24';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'h-96';\n      default:\n        return 'h-64';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get grid columns based on variant\n  const getGridColumns = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3';\n      default:\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get gap size based on variant\n  const getGap = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'gap-3';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'gap-6';\n      default:\n        return 'gap-4';\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className={cn('w-full', className)}\u003e\n      {title \u0026\u0026 (\n        \u003ch2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\"\u003e{title}\u003c/h2\u003e\n      )}\n      \n      {members.length === 0 ? (\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-500\"\u003e{emptyMessage}\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cdiv className={cn('grid', getGridColumns(), getGap())}\u003e\n          {members.map((member, index) =\u003e (\n            \u003cMemberCard\n              key={member.id}\n              profile={member}\n              index={index}\n              isFiltering={isFiltering}\n              currentUserId={currentUserId}\n              className={getCardClasses()}\n            /\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};",

}\n  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }\n}\n\n// Responsive design\n@media (max-width: 1024px) {\n  .social-dashboard {\n    .dashboard-content {\n      grid-template-columns: 1fr;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .social-dashboard {\n    padding: 16px;\n\n    .dashboard-header {\n      flex-direction: column;\n      gap: 16px;\n      text-align: center;\n\n      .header-actions {\n        flex-direction: column;\n        gap: 12px;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .tabs {\n      flex-direction: column;\n\n      .tab {\n        text-align: center;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n.card {\n  background: white;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);\n  padding: 16px;\n  margin-bottom: 16px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 16px;\n}\n\n.follower-item, .member-card, .crew-card {\n  background: #fff;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);\n  padding: 18px 22px;\n  margin-bottom: 18px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 18px;\n  min-width: 0;\n  max-width: 520px;\n}\n\n.follower-avatar, .member-avatar, .crew-avatar {\n  width: 56px;\n  height: 56px;\n  border-radius: 50%;\n  object-fit: cover;\n  border: 2px solid #e5e7eb;\n}\n\n.follower-info, .member-info, .crew-info {\n  flex: 1;\n  min-width: 0;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 2px;\n}\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": ".follower-name, .member-name, .crew-name {\n  color: #1f2937;\n  font-size: 18px;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  margin-bottom: 2px;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n\n.follower-title, .member-title, .crew-title {\n  color: #6b7280;\n  font-size: 15px;\n  font-weight: 400;\n  margin-bottom: 1px;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n\n.follower-location, .member-location, .crew-location {\n  color: #9ca3af;\n  font-size: 13px;\n  font-weight: 400;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n\n.message-btn {\n  border: 1px solid #3b82f6;\n  background: #fff;\n  color: #3b82f6;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  padding: 7px 14px;\n  font-size: 15px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 6px;\n  transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;\n}\n.message-btn:hover {\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  color: #fff;\n}\n\n.members-header {\n  margin-bottom: 18px;\n}\n.search-container {\n  margin-bottom: 12px;\n}\n\n.profile-icon, .attachment-icon, .book-icon {\n  display: none !important;\n}\n\n.user-overlay, .user-info-under-post {\n  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);\n  color: #1f2937;\n  font-size: 15px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  padding: 10px 16px;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);\n  margin-top: 8px;\n} ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "const SocialDashboard: React.FC\u003cSocialDashboardProps\u003e =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleNotificationClick = (notification: SocialNotification) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Mark notification as read\n      SocialService.markNotificationAsRead(notification.id);\n      \n      // Navigate based on notification type\n      switch (notification.type) {\n        case 'follow_request':\n          setActiveTab('requests');\n          break;\n        case 'follow_accepted':\n          setActiveTab('followers');\n          break;\n        case 'message':\n          setActiveTab('messaging');\n          break;\n        default:\n          setActiveTab('notifications');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('[SocialDashboard] Error handling notification click:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to process notification');\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleFollowRequestResponse = async (requestId: string, response: 'accepted' | 'rejected') =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await SocialService.respondToFollowRequest(requestId, response);\n      // Remove the request from the list after response\n      setFollowRequests(prev =\u003e prev.filter(req =\u003e req.id !== requestId));\n      // Mark related notifications as read\n      setNotifications(prev =\u003e prev.filter(notif =\u003e \n        !(notif.type === 'follow_request' \u0026\u0026 notif.relatedEventId === requestId)\n      ));\n      toast.success(&#96;Follow request ${response}&#96;);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error responding to follow request:', error);\n      toast.error('Failed to respond to follow request');\n    }\n  };\n\n  if (error) {\n    return (\n      \u003cdiv className=\"social-dashboard\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv         "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  static async respondToFollowRequest(requestId: string, status: 'accepted' | 'rejected'): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      const batch = writeBatch(db);\n      const requestRef = doc(db, 'followRequests', requestId);\n      \n      // Update request status\n      batch.update(requestRef, { \n        status, \n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp() \n      });\n\n      // Get the request data\n      const requestDoc = await getDoc(requestRef);\n      if (!requestDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Follow };\n        const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n        batch.set(followRef, followData);\n\n        // Create notification for the requester\n        await this.createNotification({\n         "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Send a follow request to another user\n   */\n  static async sendFollowRequest(followerId: string, followingId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check if follow relationship already exists\n      const existingFollow = await this.getFollow(followerId, followingId);\n      if (existingFollow) {\n        if (existingFollow.status === 'pending') {\n          throw new Error('Follow request already sent');\n        } else if (existingFollow.status === 'accepted') {\n          throw new Error('Already following this user');\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Create new follow request\n      const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n      await setDoc(followRef, {\n        followerId,\n        followingId,\n        status: 'pending',\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n      });\n\n      // Create notification for the user being followed\n      await this.createNotification({\n        userId: followingId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        message: 'sent you a follow request',\n        metadata: { followerId }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        ],
```
```json
        "originalContents": "\n\n  /**\n   * Send a follow request to another user\n   */\n  static async sendFollowRequest(followerId: string, followingId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check if follow relationship already exists\n      const existingFollow = await this.getFollow(followerId, followingId);\n      if (existingFollow) {\n        if (existingFollow.status === 'pending') {\n          throw new Error('Follow request already sent');\n        } else if (existingFollow.status === 'accepted') {\n          throw new Error('Already following this user');\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Create new follow request\n      const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n      await setDoc(followRef, {\n        followerId,\n        followingId,\n        status: 'pending',\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n      });\n\n      // Create notification for the user being followed\n      await this.createNotification({\n        userId: followingId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        message: 'sent you a follow request',\n        metadata: { followerId }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "const SocialTestPage: React.FC\u003cSocialTestPageProps\u003e =\n  ...\n  const runTests = async\n\n      ...\n\n      try {\n        await SocialService.sendFollowRequest(currentUserId, 'test-user-1', 'Test follow request');\n        addResult('✅ Follow request sent successfully');\n        \n        // Check if notification was created\n        setTimeout(async () =\u003e {\n          const notificationsQuery = query(\n            collection(db, 'notifications'),\n            where('userId', '==', 'test-user-1'),\n            where('type', '==', 'follow_request')\n          );\n          const snapshot = await getDocs(notificationsQuery);\n          if (!snapshot.empty) {\n            addResult(&#96;✅ Notification created: ${snapshot.docs[0].id}&#96;);\n          } else {\n            addResult('❌ No notification found');\n          }\n        }, 2000);\n        \n      } catch (error) {\n        addResult(&#96;❌ Follow request failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96;);\n      }\n      \n      addResult('🎉 All tests completed successfully!');\n      \n    } catch (error) {\n      addResult(&#96;❌ Test failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}&#96;);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };",
```

Add a static method SocialService.subscribeToOutgoingFollowRequests(userId, callback) that sets up a real-time listener for outgoing follow requests (fromUserId == userId, status == 'pending'). The callback should receive an array of FollowRequest objects, similar to subscribeToFollowRequests.

**Chunk 1**

```diff
@@ -879,3 +879,37 @@
      }
    }
+ 
+   static subscribeToOutgoingFollowRequests(userId: string, callback: (requests: FollowRequest[]) =&gt; void) {
+     try {
+       console.log('[SocialService] Setting up outgoing follow requests listener for user:', userId);
+       const requestsQuery = query(
+         collection(db, 'followRequests'),
+         where('fromUserId', '==', userId),
+         where('status', '==', 'pending'),
+         orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')
+       );
+ 
+       return onSnapshot(requestsQuery, (snapshot) =&gt; {
+         try {
+           const requests = snapshot.docs.map(doc =&gt; ({
+             id: doc.id,
+             ...doc.data(),
+             createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate(),
+             updatedAt: doc.data().updatedAt?.toDate()
+           })) as FollowRequest[];
+           console.log('[SocialService] Outgoing follow requests updated:', requests.length);
+           callback(requests);
+         } catch (error) {
+           console.error('[SocialService] Error processing outgoing follow requests snapshot:', error);
+           callback([]);
+         }
+       }, (error) =&gt; {
+         console.error('[SocialService] Outgoing follow requests listener error:', error);
+         callback([]);
+       });
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error('[SocialService] Error setting up outgoing follow requests listener:', error);
+       return () =&gt; {};
+     }
+   }
  }
```

```json
        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Respond to a follow request\n   */\n  static async respondToFollowRequest(\n    followId: string, \n    accept: boolean\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      const followRef = doc(db, 'follows', followId);\n      const followDoc = await getDoc(followRef);\n      \n      if (!followDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Follow request not found');\n      }\n\n      const followData = followDoc.data() as FollowData;\n      \n      if (accept) {\n        await updateDoc(followRef, {\n          status: 'accepted',\n          updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        });\n\n        // Create notification for the follower\n        await this.createNotification({\n          userId: followData.followerId,\n          type: 'follow_accepted',\n          message: 'accepted your follow request',\n          metadata: { followingId: followData.followingId }\n        });\n      } else {\n        await deleteDoc(followRef);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error responding to follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  /**\n   * Respond to a follow request\n   */\n  static async respondToFollowRequest(\n    followId: string, \n    accept: boolean\n  ): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      const followRef = doc(db, 'follows', followId);\n      const followDoc = await getDoc(followRef);\n      \n      if (!followDoc.exists()) {\n        throw new Error('Follow request not found');\n      }\n\n      const followData = followDoc.data() as FollowData;\n      \n      if (accept) {\n        await updateDoc(followRef, {\n          status: 'accepted',\n          updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        });\n\n        // Create notification for the follower\n        await this.createNotification({\n          userId: followData.followerId,\n          type: 'follow_accepted',\n          message: 'accepted your follow request',\n          metadata: { followingId: followData.followingId }\n        });\n      } else {\n        await deleteDoc(followRef);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error responding to follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  /**\n   * Send a follow request to another user\n   */\n  static async sendFollowRequest(followerId: string, followingId: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n    try {\n      // Check if follow relationship already exists\n      const existingFollow = await this.getFollow(followerId, followingId);\n      if (existingFollow) {\n        if (existingFollow.status === 'pending') {\n          throw new Error('Follow request already sent');\n        } else if (existingFollow.status === 'accepted') {\n          throw new Error('Already following this user');\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Create new follow request\n      const followRef = doc(collection(db, 'follows'));\n      await setDoc(followRef, {\n        followerId,\n        followingId,\n        status: 'pending',\n        createdAt: serverTimestamp(),\n        updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),\n      });\n\n      // Create notification for the user being followed\n      await this.createNotification({\n        userId: followingId,\n        type: 'follow_request',\n        message: 'sent you a follow request',\n        metadata: { followerId }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending follow request:', error);\n      throw error;\n    }\n  }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export class SocialService {\n  ...\n  static async sendFollowRequest(fromUserId: string, toUserId: string, message?: string): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n\n  ...\n\n  }\n\n  static async getFollowRequest(fromUserId: string, toUserId: string): Promise\u003cFollowRequest | null\u003e {\n    try {\n      const requestsQuery = query(\n        collection(db, 'followRequests'),\n        where('fromUserId', '==', fromUserId),\n        where('toUserId', '==', toUserId)\n      );\n      const snapshot = await getDocs(requestsQuery);\n      \n      if (!snapshot.empty) {\n        const doc = snapshot.docs[0];\n        return {\n          id: doc.id,\n          ...doc.data(),\n          createdAt: doc.data().createdAt?.toDate(),\n          updatedAt: doc.data().updatedAt?.toDate()\n        } as FollowRequest;\n      }\n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error getting follow request:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }",
```

- Optionally, run a migration to fill in missing names for old users.

### **Global Look & Feel Review: Initial Findings**

#### **1. Color Palette & Theme**
- **Modern, light, and stylized:**  
  - Uses a blue primary (`#3b82f6`), soft neutrals, and clear success/warning/error colors.
  - Consistent use of CSS variables for colors, spacing, and shadows.
  - **Dark mode support** is present via media queries.

#### **2. Typography**
- **Font:** Inter, system-ui, Arial, sans-serif (modern, readable).
- **Font weights:** 300–700, with clear mixins for sizes and line heights.
- **Consistent heading and body classes** in both CSS and SCSS.

#### **3. Spacing, Radius, and Shadows**
- **Spacing:** Uses a scale (`--space-1` to `--space-24`), and SCSS variables for spacing units.
- **Border radius:** Modern, rounded corners (`.5rem` to `1.5rem` and full).
- **Shadows:** Subtle, layered shadows for cards and overlays.

#### **4. Card & Section Design**
- **Card system:**  
  - `.card-base`, `.card-hover`, `.card-padding` for consistent card look.
  - Cards are white, rounded, with soft shadows and hover effects.
- **Section backgrounds:**  
  - `.section-light`, `.section-gray`, `.section-gradient` for clean, light backgrounds.

#### **5. Buttons & Inputs**
- **Buttons:**  
  - `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-card` for consistent button styles.
  - Rounded, modern, with clear hover/focus states.
- **Inputs:**  
  - Large, rounded, with clear focus and error states.
  - Good contrast and padding.

#### **6. Responsiveness & Accessibility**
- **Responsive classes:**  
  - Uses Tailwind and custom media queries for font sizes and layout.
- **Accessibility:**  
  - Focus states, color contrast, and alt text are present in most places.
  - Uses system fonts for better accessibility.

#### **7. Microinteractions & Animations**
- **Transitions:**  
  - Smooth transitions for cards, buttons, and overlays.
- **Skeletons & loaders:**  
  - Present for loading states.
- **Subtle hover/scale effects** on cards and buttons.

#### **8. Consistency**
- **Design tokens** are used throughout for color, spacing, and typography.
- **Card/list/grid layouts** are consistent across Social, Members, Projects, etc.
- **Modern, light, and clean look** is maintained everywhere.

## **Strengths**
- **Very modern, light, and visually appealing.**
- **Consistent use of design tokens and card system.**
- **Responsive and accessible.**
- **Subtle, non-distracting microinteractions.**
- **Dark mode support is ready.**

## **Minor Issues/Recommendations**
- **Legacy/dark theme variables** in `variables.scss` could be cleaned up if not used.
- **Ensure all custom components (modals, dropdowns, etc.) use the same design tokens.**
- **Double-check all pages for edge-case contrast/accessibility (especially overlays and error states).**

- **If you want even more modernity:**

## **SECTION 1: GLOBAL STYLES & DESIGN SYSTEM AUDIT**

1. **Comprehensive Design System**: Well-structured CSS variables with semantic color naming
2. **Modern Color Palette**: Blue-based primary colors with proper contrast ratios
3. **Consistent Spacing**: 4px grid system with logical scale
4. **Typography System**: Good font hierarchy with Inter font family
5. **Dark Mode Support**: Proper CSS custom properties for theme switching
6. **Animation System**: Smooth transitions and hover effects

### ⚠️ **Issues Found:**

2. **Inconsistent Card Styling**: Multiple card classes that may conflict

```json
        "originalContents": "  .load-more-trigger {\n    display: flex;\n    justify-content: center;\n    padding: 20px;\n\n    .loading-indicator {\n      display: flex;\n      align-items: center;\n      gap: 12px;\n      color: #6b7280;\n      font-size: 14px;\n\n      .spinner {\n        width: 20px;\n        height: 20px;\n        border: 2px solid #e5e7eb;\n        border-top: 2px solid #3b82f6;\n        border-radius: 50%;\n        animation: spin 1s linear infinite;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  .activity-feed-error {\n    text-align: center;\n    padding: 40px 20px;\n    color: #dc2626;\n\n    .error-icon {\n      font-size: 32px;\n      margin-bottom: 16px;\n    }\n\n    p {\n      margin-bottom: 16px;\n      font-size: 14px;\n    }\n\n    .retry-button {\n      padding: 8px 16px;\n      background: #dc2626;\n      color: white;\n      border: none;\n      border-radius: 6px;\n      font-size: 14px;\n      cursor: pointer;\n      transition: background-color 0.2s ease;\n\n      \u0026:hover {\n        background: #b91c1c;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  .performance-stats {\n    margin-top: 20px;\n    padding: 12px;\n    background: #f9fafb;\n    border-radius: 6px;\n    text-align: center;\n    border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n\n    small {\n      color: #6b7280;\n      font-size: 12px;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Animations\n@keyframes spin {\n  from {\n    transform: rotate(0deg);\n  }\n  to {\n    transform: rotate(360deg);\n  }\n}\n\n// Responsive design\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .activity-feed {\n    padding: 16px;\n\n    .activity-controls {\n      flex-direction: column;\n      align-items: stretch;\n\n      .search-container {\n        min-width: auto;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .activities-list {\n      .activity-item {\n        padding: 16px;\n\n        .activity-header {\n          .user-avatar {\n            width: 40px;\n            height: 40px;\n          }\n        }\n\n        .activity-actions {\n          gap: 12px;\n\n          .action-button {\n            padding: 6px 10px;\n            font-size: 12px;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Performance optimizations\n",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "      .activity-content {\n        margin-bottom: 16px;\n\n        .activity-title {\n          font-size: 16px;\n          font-weight: 600;\n          color: #111827;\n          margin-bottom: 8px;\n          line-height: 1.4;\n        }\n\n        .activity-description {\n          font-size: 14px;\n          color: #4b5563;\n          line-height: 1.5;\n          margin-bottom: 12px;\n        }\n\n        .activity-image {\n          border-radius: 8px;\n          overflow: hidden;\n          margin-top: 12px;\n\n          img {\n            width: 100%;\n            height: auto;\n            display: block;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      .activity-actions {\n        display: flex;\n        gap: 16px;\n        padding-top: 16px;\n        border-top: 1px solid #f3f4f6;\n\n        .action-button {\n          display: flex;\n          align-items: center;\n          gap: 6px;\n          padding: 8px 12px;\n          border: none;\n          background: transparent;\n          border-radius: 6px;\n          font-size: 13px;\n          color: #6b7280;\n          cursor: pointer;\n          transition: all 0.2s ease;\n\n          \u0026:hover {\n            background: #f9fafb;\n            color: #374151;\n          }\n\n          \u0026.liked {\n            color: #ef4444;\n          }\n\n          .icon {\n            font-size: 16px;\n          }\n\n          .count {\n            font-weight: 500;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  .empty-state {\n    text-align: center;\n    padding: 60px 20px;\n    color: #6b7280;\n\n    .empty-icon {\n      font-size: 48px;\n      margin-bottom: 16px;\n      opacity: 0.5;\n    }\n\n    h3 {\n      font-size: 18px;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      margin-bottom: 8px;\n      color: #374151;\n    }\n\n    p {\n      font-size: 14px;\n    }\n  }\n\n",

        "contents": ".activity-feed {\n  max-width: 800px;\n  margin: 0 auto;\n  padding: 20px;\n\n  .activity-controls {\n    display: flex;\n    gap: 16px;\n    margin-bottom: 24px;\n    align-items: center;\n    flex-wrap: wrap;\n\n    .search-container {\n      flex: 1;\n      min-width: 200px;\n\n      .search-input {\n        width: 100%;\n        padding: 12px 16px;\n        border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n        border-radius: 8px;\n        font-size: 14px;\n        transition: border-color 0.2s ease;\n\n        \u0026:focus {\n          outline: none;\n          border-color: #3b82f6;\n          box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1);\n        }\n\n        \u0026::placeholder {\n          color: #9ca3af;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    .filter-container {\n      .filter-select {\n        padding: 12px 16px;\n        border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n        border-radius: 8px;\n        font-size: 14px;\n        background-color: white;\n        cursor: pointer;\n        transition: border-color 0.2s ease;\n\n        \u0026:focus {\n          outline: none;\n          border-color: #3b82f6;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Loading skeleton component for better perceived performance\n  const ActivitySkeleton = useMemo(() =\u003e () =\u003e (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"activity-card card skeleton\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"activity-header\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"user-avatar skeleton-avatar\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"activity-info\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"user-name skeleton-text\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className=\"activity-time skeleton-text-small\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"activity-content\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"activity-title skeleton-text\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"activity-description skeleton-text\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"activity-description skeleton-text-short\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"activity-actions\"\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"action-button skeleton-button\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003cdiv className=\"action-button skeleton-button\"\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  ), []);\n\n  // Render loading skeletons\n  const renderLoadingSkeletons = () =\u003e {\n    return Array.from({ length: 3 }, (_, index) =\u003e (\n      \u003cActivitySkeleton key={&#96;skeleton-${index}&#96;} /\u003e\n    ));\n  };\n\n  const formatTimeAgo = (date: Date) =\u003e {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const diffInMinutes = Math.floor((now.getTime() -         "contents": "  .feed-container {\n    .feed-item {\n      background: #fff;\n      border: 1px solid #e9ecef;\n      border-radius: 12px;\n      padding: 20px;\n      margin-bottom: 20px;\n      transition: all 0.3s ease;\n\n      \u0026:hover {\n        box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n        transform: translateY(-2px);\n      }\n\n      .feed-item-header {\n        display: flex;\n        align-items: center;\n        margin-bottom: 15px;\n\n        .author-avatar {\n          width: 50px;\n          height: 50px;\n          border-radius: 50%;\n          margin-right: 15px;\n          border: 3px solid #ecf0f1;\n        }\n\n        .author-info {\n          flex: 1;\n\n          h4 {\n            font-size: 1.1rem;\n            font-weight: 600;\n            color: #2c3e50;\n            margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n          }\n\n          .author-bio {\n            font-size: 0.9rem;\n            color: #7f8c8d;\n            display: block;\n            margin-bottom: 3px;\n          }\n\n          .timestamp {\n            font-size: 0.8rem;\n            color: #bdc3c7;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      .feed-item-content {\n        margin-bottom: 15px;\n\n        p {\n          font-size: 1rem;\n          line-height: 1.6;\n          color: #2c3e50;\n          margin: 0 0 10px 0;\n        }\n\n        .tags {\n          display: flex;\n          flex-wrap: wrap;\n          gap: 8px;\n\n          .tag {\n            background: #ecf0f1;\n            color: #34495e;\n            padding: 4px 12px;\n            border-radius: 15px;\n            font-size: 0.8rem;\n            font-weight: 500;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "      .feed-item-actions {\n        display: flex;\n        gap: 20px;\n\n        .action-btn {\n          background: none;\n          border: none;\n          color: #7f8c8d;\n          font-size: 0.9rem;\n          cursor: pointer;\n          padding: 8px 12px;\n          border-radius: 20px;\n          transition: all 0.3s ease;\n\n          \u0026:hover {\n            background: #f8f9fa;\n            color: #667eea;\n          }\n\n          span {\n            margin-right: 5px;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Discover Styles\n  .discover-container {\n    .profiles-grid {\n      display: grid;\n      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));\n      gap: 20px;\n\n      .profile-card {\n        background: #fff;\n        border: 1px solid #e9ecef;\n        border-radius: 12px;\n        padding: 20px;\n        transition: all 0.3s ease;\n\n        \u0026:hover {\n          box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n          transform: translateY(-3px);\n        }\n\n        .profile-header {\n          display: flex;\n          align-items: center;\n          margin-bottom: 15px;\n\n          .profile-avatar {\n            width: 60px;\n            height: 60px;\n            border-radius: 50%;\n            margin-right: 15px;\n            border: 3px solid #ecf0f1;\n          }\n\n          .profile-info {\n            flex: 1;\n\n            h4 {\n              font-size: 1.2rem;\n              font-weight: 600;\n              color: #2c3e50;\n              margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n            }\n\n            .profile-bio {\n              font-size: 0.9rem;\n              color: #7f8c8d;\n              margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n              line-height: 1.4;\n            }\n\n            .profile-location,\n            .profile-department {\n              font-size: 0.8rem;\n              color: #bdc3c7;\n              margin: 2px 0;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n",

        "originalContents": "      .feed-item-actions {\n        display: flex;\n        gap: 20px;\n\n        .action-btn {\n          background: none;\n          border: none;\n          color: #7f8c8d;\n          font-size: 0.9rem;\n          cursor: pointer;\n          padding: 8px 12px;\n          border-radius: 20px;\n          transition: all 0.3s ease;\n\n          \u0026:hover {\n            background: #f8f9fa;\n            color: #667eea;\n          }\n\n          span {\n            margin-right: 5px;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Discover Styles\n  .discover-container {\n    .profiles-grid {\n      display: grid;\n      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));\n      gap: 20px;\n\n      .profile-card {\n        background: #fff;\n        border: 1px solid #e9ecef;\n        border-radius: 12px;\n        padding: 20px;\n        transition: all 0.3s ease;\n\n        \u0026:hover {\n          box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n          transform: translateY(-3px);\n        }\n\n        .profile-header {\n          display: flex;\n          align-items: center;\n          margin-bottom: 15px;\n\n          .profile-avatar {\n            width: 60px;\n            height: 60px;\n            border-radius: 50%;\n            margin-right: 15px;\n            border: 3px solid #ecf0f1;\n          }\n\n          .profile-info {\n            flex: 1;\n\n            h4 {\n              font-size: 1.2rem;\n              font-weight: 600;\n              color: #2c3e50;\n              margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n            }\n\n            .profile-bio {\n              font-size: 0.9rem;\n              color: #7f8c8d;\n              margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n              line-height: 1.4;\n            }\n\n            .profile-location,\n            .profile-department {\n              font-size: 0.8rem;\n              color: #bdc3c7;\n              margin: 2px 0;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n",

        "contents": "  .error-state {\n    display: flex;\n    flex-direction: column;\n    align-items: center;\n    justify-content: center;\n    height: 400px;\n    color: #ef4444;\n    text-align: center;\n\n    h3 {\n      font-size: 20px;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      margin: 0 0 12px 0;\n    }\n\n    p {\n      font-size: 14px;\n      margin: 0 0 20px 0;\n      color: #6b7280;\n    }\n\n    button {\n      background: #3b82f6;\n      color: white;\n      border: none;\n      padding: 12px 24px;\n      border-radius: 8px;\n      font-size: 14px;\n      font-weight: 500;\n      cursor: pointer;\n      transition: all 0.2s ease;\n\n      \u0026:hover {\n        background: #2563eb;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes spin {\n  0% { transform: rotate(0deg); }\n  100% { transform: rotate(360deg); }\n}\n\n// Responsive design\n@media (max-width: 1024px) {\n  .social-dashboard {\n    .dashboard-content {\n      grid-template-columns: 1fr;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .social-dashboard {\n    padding: 16px;\n\n    .dashboard-header {\n      flex-direction: column;\n      gap: 16px;\n      text-align: center;\n\n      .header-actions {\n        flex-direction: column;\n        gap: 12px;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .tabs {\n      flex-direction: column;\n\n      .tab {\n        text-align: center;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n.card {\n  background: white;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n  box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);\n  padding: 16px;\n  margin-bottom: 16px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 16px;\n}\n\n.follower-item, .member-card, .crew-card {\n  background: #fff;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);\n  padding: 18px 22px;\n  margin-bottom: 18px;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 18px;\n  min-width: 0;\n  max-width: 520px;\n}\n\n.follower-avatar, .member-avatar, .crew-avatar {\n  width: 56px;\n  height: 56px;\n  border-radius: 50%;\n  object-fit: cover;\n  border: 2px solid #e5e7eb;\n}\n\n.follower-info, .member-info, .crew-info {\n  flex: 1;\n  min-width: 0;\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 2px;\n}\n\n",

        "contents": "        .event-actions {\n          display: flex;\n          gap: 10px;\n\n          .btn-primary,\n          .btn-secondary {\n            flex: 1;\n            padding: 10px 15px;\n            border: none;\n            border-radius: 8px;\n            font-weight: 500;\n            cursor: pointer;\n            transition: all 0.3s ease;\n          }\n\n          .btn-primary {\n            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);\n            color: white;\n\n            \u0026:hover {\n              transform: translateY(-2px);\n              box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);\n            }\n          }\n\n          .btn-secondary {\n            background: #f8f9fa;\n            color: #6c757d;\n            border: 1px solid #e9ecef;\n\n            \u0026:hover {\n              background: #e9ecef;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Connections Styles\n  .connections-container {\n    text-align: center;\n    padding: 50px 20px;\n\n    p {\n      font-size: 1.1rem;\n      color: #7f8c8d;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Responsive Design\n@media (max-width: 768px) {\n  .networking-hub {\n    padding: 15px;\n\n    .hub-header {\n      h2 {\n        font-size: 2rem;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .hub-navigation {\n      gap: 8px;\n\n      .nav-tab {\n        padding: 10px 15px;\n        font-size: 0.9rem;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .discover-container .profiles-grid,\n    .groups-container .groups-grid,\n    .events-container .events-grid {\n      grid-template-columns: 1fr;\n    }\n\n    .feed-item {\n      .feed-item-header {\n        .author-avatar {\n          width: 40px;\n          height: 40px;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    .profile-card,\n    .group-card,\n    .event-card {\n      .profile-header,\n      .group-header {\n        .profile-avatar,\n        .group-avatar {\n          width: 50px;\n          height: 50px;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n} ",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  .insights-section {\n    background: white;\n    padding: 1.5rem;\n    border-radius: 1rem;\n    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n\n    h3 {\n      font-size: 1.25rem;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      color: #1a202c;\n      margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;\n    }\n\n    .insights-grid {\n      display: grid;\n      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));\n      gap: 1.5rem;\n\n      .insight-card {\n        display: flex;\n        align-items: flex-start;\n        gap: 1rem;\n        padding: 1rem;\n        background: #f8fafc;\n        border-radius: 0.75rem;\n        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n\n        .insight-icon {\n          font-size: 1.5rem;\n          flex-shrink: 0;\n        }\n\n        .insight-content {\n          h4 {\n            font-size: 1rem;\n            font-weight: 600;\n            color: #1a202c;\n            margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;\n          }\n\n          p {\n            font-size: 0.875rem;\n            color: #64748b;\n            margin: 0;\n            line-height: 1.5;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Loading states\n  .loading-skeleton {\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));\n    gap: 1.5rem;\n\n    .skeleton-card {\n      height: 120px;\n      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f0f0f0 25%, #e0e0e0 50%, #f0f0f0 75%);\n      background-size: 200% 100%;\n      animation: loading 1.5s infinite;\n      border-radius: 1rem;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .error-message {\n    background: #fef2f2;\n    color: #dc2626;\n    padding: 1rem;\n    border-radius: 0.5rem;\n    border: 1px solid #fecaca;\n    text-align: center;\n  }\n\n  .no-data {\n    background: #f8fafc;\n    color: #64748b;\n    padding: 2rem;\n    border-radius: 0.5rem;\n    text-align: center;\n    border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1;\n  }\n\n  @keyframes loading {\n    0% {\n      background-position: 200% 0;\n    }\n    100% {\n      background-position: -200% 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Responsive design\n",

        "contents": "  .metrics-cards {\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));\n    gap: 1.5rem;\n    margin-bottom: 2rem;\n\n    .metric-card {\n      background: white;\n      padding: 1.5rem;\n      border-radius: 1rem;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n      transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;\n\n      \u0026:hover {\n        transform: translateY(-2px);\n        box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n      }\n\n      .metric-icon {\n        font-size: 2rem;\n        margin-bottom: 1rem;\n      }\n\n      .metric-content {\n        h3 {\n          font-size: 0.875rem;\n          font-weight: 600;\n          color: #64748b;\n          margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;\n          text-transform: uppercase;\n          letter-spacing: 0.05em;\n        }\n\n        .metric-value {\n          font-size: 2rem;\n          font-weight: 700;\n          color: #1a202c;\n          margin-bottom: 0.5rem;\n        }\n\n        .metric-change {\n          font-size: 0.875rem;\n          font-weight: 500;\n\n          \u0026.positive {\n            color: #059669;\n          }\n\n          \u0026.negative {\n            color: #dc2626;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  .charts-section {\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(400px, 1fr));\n    gap: 2rem;\n    margin-bottom: 2rem;\n\n    .chart-container {\n      background: white;\n      padding: 1.5rem;\n      border-radius: 1rem;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n      border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n\n      h3 {\n        font-size: 1.125rem;\n        font-weight: 600;\n        color: #1a202c;\n        margin: 0 0 1rem 0;\n        text-align: center;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n",
```

```diff
+ interface FormSelectOption {

+ 
+ interface FormSelectProps extends Omit&lt;React.SelectHTMLAttributes&lt;HTMLSelectElement&gt;, 'onChange'&gt; {

+             {label}
+           &lt;/label&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       
+       {(error || helperText) &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className="flex items-start space-x-2 ml-8"&gt;
+           {error &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-red-600 flex items-center"&gt;
+               &lt;span className="w-1 h-1 bg-red-600 rounded-full mr-2"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
+               {error}
+             &lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+           {helperText &amp;&amp; !error &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500"&gt;{helperText}&lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ });
+ 
+ FormCheckbox.displayName = 'FormCheckbox';
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // FORM RADIO COMPONENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ interface FormRadioProps extends Omit&lt;React.InputHTMLAttributes&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;, 'type'&gt; {
+   label?: string;
+   error?: string;
+   helperText?: string;
+   size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
+   onChange?: (value: string) =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ export const FormRadio = forwardRef&lt;HTMLInputElement, FormRadioProps&gt;(({
+   label,
+   error,
+   helperText,
+   size = 'md',
+   className,
+   id,
+   onChange,
+   ...props
+ }, ref) =&gt; {
+   const radioId = id || &#96;radio-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}&#96;;
+ 
+   const radioClasses = clsx(
+     'form-radio',
+     'border-gray-300 text-blue-600',
+     'focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2',
+     'transition-all duration-200',
+     {
+       'border-red-300 focus:ring-red-500': error,
+       'h-4 w-4': size === 'sm',
+       'h-5 w-5': size === 'md',
+       'h-6 w-6': size === 'lg',
+     },
+     className
+   );
+ 
+   const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;) =&gt; {
+     if (onChange) {
+       onChange(e.target.value);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="space-y-1"&gt;
+       &lt;div className="flex items-start space-x-3"&gt;
+         &lt;input
+           ref={ref}
+           type="radio"
+           id={radioId}
+           className={radioClasses}
+           onChange={handleChange}
+           {...props}
+         /&gt;
+         {label &amp;&amp; (
+           &lt;label 
+             htmlFor={radioId}
+             className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 cursor-pointer select-none"
+           &gt;
+             {label}
+           &lt;/label&gt;
+         )}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       
+       {(error || helperText) &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className="flex items-start space-x-2 ml-8"&gt;
+           {error &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-red-600 flex items-center"&gt;
+               &lt;span className="w-1 h-1 bg-red-600 rounded-full mr-2"&gt;&lt;/span&gt;
+               {error}
+             &lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+           {helperText &amp;&amp; !error &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-500"&gt;{helperText}&lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ });
+ 
+ FormRadio.displayName = 'FormRadio';
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // FORM FIELD GROUP COMPONENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ interface FormFieldGroupProps {
+   children: React.ReactNode;
+   title?: string;
+   description?: string;
+   className?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export const FormFieldGroup: React.FC&lt;FormFieldGroupProps&gt; = ({
+   children,
+   title,
+   description,
+   className
+ }) =&gt; {
+   return (
+     &lt;div className={clsx('space-y-4', className)}&gt;
+       {(title || description) &amp;&amp; (
+         &lt;div className="space-y-1"&gt;
+           {title &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-900"&gt;{title}&lt;/h3&gt;
+           )}
+           {description &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-600"&gt;{description}&lt;/p&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       )}
+       &lt;div className="space-y-4"&gt;
+         {children}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // ============================================================================
+ // FORM COMPONENT
+ // ============================================================================
+ 
+ interface FormProps extends React.FormHTMLAttributes&lt;HTMLFormElement&gt; {
+   children: React.ReactNode;
+   onSubmit?: (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; void;
+   className?: string;
+ }
+ 
+ export const Form: React.FC&lt;FormProps&gt; = ({
+   children,
+   onSubmit,
+   className,
+   ...props
+ }) =&gt; {
+   const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {
+     e.preventDefault();
+     if (onSubmit) {
+       onSubmit(e);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;motion.form
+       initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
+       animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
+       transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
+       onSubmit={handleSubmit}
+       className={clsx('space-y-6', className)}
+       {...props}
+     &gt;
+       {children}
+     &lt;/motion.form&gt;
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ // Export all components
+ export {
+   FormInput,
+   FormTextarea,
+   FormSelect,
+   FormCheckbox,
+   FormRadio,
+   FormFieldGroup,
+   Form
+ }; 
```

Perfect! I've completely fixed the SocialDashboard with the following improvements:

## ✅ **Fixed Issues**

### 1. **Real Social Functionality**
- **Removed mock data** and implemented real-time subscriptions using actual SocialService methods
- **Follow requests**: Uses `subscribeToFollowRequests()` and `respondToFollowRequest()`
- **Following/Followers**: Uses `subscribeToFollowing()` and `subscribeToFollowers()`
- **Follow actions**: Uses `sendFollowRequest()` and `unfollow()` methods
- **Outgoing requests**: Uses `subscribeToOutgoingFollowRequests()`

### 2. **Light Theme Design**
- **Background**: Changed from dark to light gray (`bg-gray-50`)
- **Cards**: Modern white cards with subtle shadows and rounded corners
- **Stats cards**: Beautiful gradient icons with hover effects
- **User cards**: Clean white cards with gradient avatars and modern styling

### 3. **Modern Card Design**
- **Gradient avatars**: Beautiful blue-to-purple gradients for user avatars
- **Enhanced shadows**: Subtle shadows with hover effects
- **Rounded corners**: Modern `rounded-xl` design
- **Colorful buttons**: Green for accept, red for reject, blue for follow
- **Smooth transitions**: Hover effects and animations

### 4. **Proper Data Handling**
- **User data extraction**: Helper function to extract user info from Follow/FollowRequest objects
- **Real-time updates**: Live subscriptions that update the UI automatically
- **Error handling**: Proper error messages and loading states

## 🎨 **Visual Improvements**

- **Light, modern theme** with clean white cards
- **Gradient icons** in stats cards (blue, yellow, green, purple)
- **Enhanced user cards** with gradient avatars and modern styling
- **Colorful action buttons** with proper hover states
- **Smooth animations** and transitions throughout

## 🔧 **Technical Fixes**

- **Real Firebase subscriptions** instead of mock data
- **Proper TypeScript types** using FollowRequest and Follow interfaces
- **Correct method calls** to SocialService
- **Async/await handling** for all social actions
- **Cleanup functions** for subscriptions

The SocialDashboard now works with real data and has a beautiful, modern light theme that matches your preferences. You can now see your actual followers, following, and follow requests with full functionality!

```json
        "contents": "          .member-card {\n            background: white;\n            border-radius: 16px;\n            padding: 20px;\n            box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n            transition: all 0.3s ease;\n            position: relative;\n\n            \u0026:hover {\n              box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n              transform: translateY(-2px);\n            }\n\n            .member-avatar {\n              position: relative;\n              margin-bottom: 16px;\n\n              img {\n                width: 60px;\n                height: 60px;\n                border-radius: 50%;\n                object-fit: cover;\n                border: 3px solid #e5e7eb;\n              }\n\n              .bookmark-btn {\n                position: absolute;\n                top: -5px;\n                right: -5px;\n                background: white;\n                border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;\n                border-radius: 50%;\n                width: 30px;\n                height: 30px;\n                display: flex;\n                align-items: center;\n                justify-content: center;\n                cursor: pointer;\n                transition: all 0.2s ease;\n                font-size: 14px;\n\n                \u0026:hover {\n                  background: #f3f4f6;\n                  transform: scale(1.1);\n                }\n              }\n            }\n\n            .member-info {\n              margin-bottom: 16px;\n\n              h4 {\n                font-size: 16px;\n                font-weight: 600;\n                color: #1f2937;\n                margin: 0 0 4px 0;\n              }\n\n              .member-title {\n                font-size: 14px;\n                color: #6b7280;\n                margin: 0 0 4px 0;\n              }\n\n              .member-location {\n                font-size: 13px;\n                color: #9ca3af;\n                margin: 0;\n              }\n            }\n\n",

        "contents": ".follower-name, .member-name, .crew-name {\n  color: #1f2937;\n  font-size: 18px;\n  font-weight: 600;\n  margin-bottom: 2px;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n\n.follower-title, .member-title, .crew-title {\n  color: #6b7280;\n  font-size: 15px;\n  font-weight: 400;\n  margin-bottom: 1px;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n\n.follower-location, .member-location, .crew-location {\n  color: #9ca3af;\n  font-size: 13px;\n  font-weight: 400;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  overflow: hidden;\n  text-overflow: ellipsis;\n}\n\n.message-btn {\n  border: 1px solid #3b82f6;\n  background: #fff;\n  color: #3b82f6;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  padding: 7px 14px;\n  font-size: 15px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 6px;\n  transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;\n}\n.message-btn:hover {\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  color: #fff;\n}\n\n.members-header {\n  margin-bottom: 18px;\n}\n.search-container {\n  margin-bottom: 12px;\n}\n\n.profile-icon, .attachment-icon, .book-icon {\n  display: none !important;\n}\n\n.user-overlay, .user-info-under-post {\n  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);\n  color: #1f2937;\n  font-size: 15px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  padding: 10px 16px;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);\n  margin-top: 8px;\n} ",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  .dashboard-content {\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;\n    gap: 24px;\n\n    .main-content {\n      background: white;\n      border-radius: 16px;\n      padding: 24px;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n      min-height: 600px;\n\n      .analytics-section,\n      .messaging-section {\n        height: 100%;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .sidebar {\n      display: flex;\n      flex-direction: column;\n      gap: 24px;\n\n      .user-info-card {\n        background: white;\n        border-radius: 16px;\n        padding: 24px;\n        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n\n        .user-avatar-section {\n          display: flex;\n          align-items: center;\n          gap: 16px;\n          margin-bottom: 20px;\n\n          .user-avatar {\n            width: 60px;\n            height: 60px;\n            border-radius: 50%;\n            object-fit: cover;\n            border: 3px solid #e5e7eb;\n          }\n\n          .user-details {\n            h3 {\n              font-size: 16px;\n              font-weight: 600;\n              color: #1f2937;\n              margin: 0 0 4px 0;\n            }\n\n            .user-handle {\n              font-size: 13px;\n              color: #6b7280;\n              margin: 0;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        .user-stats {\n          display: flex;\n          gap: 16px;\n\n          .stat {\n            flex: 1;\n            text-align: center;\n            padding: 12px;\n            background: #f9fafb;\n            border-radius: 12px;\n\n            .stat-number {\n              display: block;\n              font-size: 20px;\n              font-weight: 700;\n              color: #1f2937;\n            }\n\n            .stat-label {\n              font-size: 12px;\n              color: #6b7280;\n              text-transform: uppercase;\n              letter-spacing: 0.5px;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n",

        "originalContents": "  .dashboard-content {\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: 1fr 320px;\n    gap: 24px;\n\n    .main-content {\n      background: white;\n      border-radius: 16px;\n      padding: 24px;\n      box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n      min-height: 600px;\n\n      .analytics-section,\n      .messaging-section {\n        height: 100%;\n      }\n    }\n\n    .sidebar {\n      display: flex;\n      flex-direction: column;\n      gap: 24px;\n\n      .user-info-card {\n        background: white;\n        border-radius: 16px;\n        padding: 24px;\n        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);\n\n        .user-avatar-section {\n          display: flex;\n          align-items: center;\n          gap: 16px;\n          margin-bottom: 20px;\n\n          .user-avatar {\n            width: 60px;\n            height: 60px;\n            border-radius: 50%;\n            object-fit: cover;\n            border: 3px solid #e5e7eb;\n          }\n\n          .user-details {\n            h3 {\n              font-size: 16px;\n              font-weight: 600;\n              color: #1f2937;\n              margin: 0 0 4px 0;\n            }\n\n            .user-handle {\n              font-size: 13px;\n              color: #6b7280;\n              margin: 0;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        .user-stats {\n          display: flex;\n          gap: 16px;\n\n          .stat {\n            flex: 1;\n            text-align: center;\n            padding: 12px;\n            background: #f9fafb;\n            border-radius: 12px;\n\n            .stat-number {\n              display: block;\n              font-size: 20px;\n              font-weight: 700;\n              color: #1f2937;\n            }\n\n            .stat-label {\n              font-size: 12px;\n              color: #6b7280;\n              text-transform: uppercase;\n              letter-spacing: 0.5px;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\nconst MembersList: React.FC\u003cMembersListProps\u003e = ({\n  members,\n  title,\n  variant = 'default',\n  emptyMessage = 'No members to display',\n  className = '',\n  currentUserId,\n  isFiltering = false,\n}) =\u003e {\n  // Get card classes based on variant\n  const getCardClasses = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'h-24';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'h-96';\n      default:\n        return 'h-64';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get grid columns based on variant\n  const getGridColumns = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3';\n      default:\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get gap size based on variant\n  const getGap = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'gap-3';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'gap-6';\n      default:\n        return 'gap-4';\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className={cn('w-full', className)}\u003e\n      {title \u0026\u0026 (\n        \u003ch2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\"\u003e{title}\u003c/h2\u003e\n      )}\n      \n      {members.length === 0 ? (\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-500\"\u003e{emptyMessage}\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cdiv className={cn('grid', getGridColumns(), getGap())}\u003e\n          {members.map((member, index) =\u003e (\n            \u003cMemberCard\n              key={member.id}\n              profile={member}\n              index={index}\n              isFiltering={isFiltering}\n              currentUserId={currentUserId}\n              className={getCardClasses()}\n            /\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },

            "lineNumber": 15
          },

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst MembersList: React.FC\u003cMembersListProps\u003e = ({\n  members,\n  title,\n  variant = 'default',\n  emptyMessage = 'No members to display',\n  className = '',\n  currentUserId,\n  isFiltering = false,\n}) =\u003e {\n  // Get card classes based on variant\n  const getCardClasses = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'h-24';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'h-96';\n      default:\n        return 'h-64';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get grid columns based on variant\n  const getGridColumns = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3';\n      default:\n        return 'grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 2xl:grid-cols-5';\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Get gap size based on variant\n  const getGap = () =\u003e {\n    switch (variant) {\n      case 'compact':\n        return 'gap-3';\n      case 'detailed':\n        return 'gap-6';\n      default:\n        return 'gap-4';\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className={cn('w-full', className)}\u003e\n      {title \u0026\u0026 (\n        \u003ch2 className=\"text-xl font-semibold text-gray-900 mb-4\"\u003e{title}\u003c/h2\u003e\n      )}\n      \n      {members.length === 0 ? (\n        \u003cdiv className=\"text-center py-8\"\u003e\n          \u003cp className=\"text-gray-500\"\u003e{emptyMessage}\u003c/p\u003e\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cdiv className={cn('grid', getGridColumns(), getGap())}\u003e\n          {members.map((member, index) =\u003e (\n            \u003cMemberCard\n              key={member.id}\n              profile={member}\n              index={index}\n              isFiltering={isFiltering}\n              currentUserId={currentUserId}\n              className={getCardClasses()}\n            /\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/div\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  );\n};",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  .groups-container {\n    .groups-grid {\n      display: grid;\n      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(350px, 1fr));\n      gap: 20px;\n\n      .group-card {\n        background: #fff;\n        border: 1px solid #e9ecef;\n        border-radius: 12px;\n        padding: 20px;\n        transition: all 0.3s ease;\n\n        \u0026:hover {\n          box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n          transform: translateY(-3px);\n        }\n\n        .group-header {\n          display: flex;\n          align-items: center;\n          margin-bottom: 15px;\n\n          .group-avatar {\n            width: 60px;\n            height: 60px;\n            border-radius: 12px;\n            margin-right: 15px;\n            border: 3px solid #ecf0f1;\n          }\n\n          .group-info {\n            flex: 1;\n\n            h4 {\n              font-size: 1.2rem;\n              font-weight: 600;\n              color: #2c3e50;\n              margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n            }\n\n            .group-description {\n              font-size: 0.9rem;\n              color: #7f8c8d;\n              margin: 0 0 5px 0;\n              line-height: 1.4;\n            }\n\n            .group-department {\n              font-size: 0.8rem;\n              color: #bdc3c7;\n              margin: 0;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n\n        .group-stats {\n          display: flex;\n          gap: 15px;\n          margin-bottom: 15px;\n          font-size: 0.9rem;\n          color: #7f8c8d;\n        }\n\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  .insights-section {\n    background: white;\n    padding: 1.5rem;\n    border-radius: 1rem;\n    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n    border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n\n    h3 {\n      font-size: 1.25rem;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      color: #1a202c;\n      margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;\n    }\n\n    .insights-grid {\n      display: grid;\n      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));\n      gap: 1.5rem;\n\n      .insight-card {\n        display: flex;\n        align-items: flex-start;\n        gap: 1rem;\n        padding: 1rem;\n        background: #f8fafc;\n        border-radius: 0.75rem;\n        border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n\n        .insight-icon {\n          font-size: 1.5rem;\n          flex-shrink: 0;\n        }\n\n        .insight-content {\n          h4 {\n            font-size: 1rem;\n            font-weight: 600;\n            color: #1a202c;\n            margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;\n          }\n\n          p {\n            font-size: 0.875rem;\n            color: #64748b;\n            margin: 0;\n            line-height: 1.5;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Loading states\n  .loading-skeleton {\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr));\n    gap: 1.5rem;\n\n    .skeleton-card {\n      height: 120px;\n      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f0f0f0 25%, #e0e0e0 50%, #f0f0f0 75%);\n      background-size: 200% 100%;\n      animation: loading 1.5s infinite;\n      border-radius: 1rem;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .error-message {\n    background: #fef2f2;\n    color: #dc2626;\n    padding: 1rem;\n    border-radius: 0.5rem;\n    border: 1px solid #fecaca;\n    text-align: center;\n  }\n\n  .no-data {\n    background: #f8fafc;\n    color: #64748b;\n    padding: 2rem;\n    border-radius: 0.5rem;\n    text-align: center;\n    border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1;\n  }\n\n  @keyframes loading {\n    0% {\n      background-position: 200% 0;\n    }\n    100% {\n      background-position: -200% 0;\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Responsive design\n",
```

Perfect! Now the design is much more sleek and modern. Here's what I've refined to make it more elegant:

## ✨ **Sleek & Modern Improvements:**

### **1. Reduced Sizes & Compact Design**
- **Smaller containers**: `max-w-5xl` instead of `max-w-6xl`
- **Reduced padding**: `p-4` instead of `p-6` for tighter spacing
- **Compact cards**: `p-4` instead of `p-6` for user cards
- **Smaller icons**: `w-3 h-3` and `w-4 h-4` instead of larger sizes

### **2. Refined Typography**
- **Header**: `text-2xl` instead of `text-4xl` for better proportion
- **Subtitle**: `text-sm` instead of `text-lg` for subtlety
- **User names**: `text-base` instead of `text-xl` for elegance
- **Stats**: `text-xl` instead of `text-3xl` for balance

### **3. Streamlined Components**
- **Stats cards**: `grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4` for better mobile layout
- **Tab buttons**: `px-4 py-2` instead of `px-6 py-3` for compactness
- **Action buttons**: `px-3 py-1.5` for refined proportions
- **Profile images**: `w-12 h-12` instead of `w-16 h-16`

### **4. Subtle Visual Refinements**
- **Rounded corners**: `rounded-xl` instead of `rounded-2xl` for elegance
- **Shadows**: `shadow-lg` instead of `shadow-xl` for subtlety
- **Spacing**: Reduced gaps between elements
- **Border radius**: `rounded-lg` for buttons and inputs

### **5. Better Information Hierarchy**
- **Compact stats**: Shorter labels like "Pending" instead of "Pending Requests"
- **Smaller metadata**: `text-xs` for ratings and engagement
- **Tighter spacing**: Reduced margins and padding throughout
- **Efficient use of space**: More content visible without scrolling

The design now feels much more **modern, sleek, and professional** while maintaining all the functionality. It's compact, elegant, and makes efficient use of screen space without feeling cramped. The proportions are now perfect for a contemporary web application! 🎯

```json
        "contents": "\n\nconst QuickMessage: React.FC\u003cQuickMessageProps\u003e = ({ \n  currentUserId, \n  targetUserId, \n  targetUserName = 'this user',\n  onMessageSent,\n  className = ''\n}) =\u003e {\n  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);\n  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [canMessage, setCanMessage] = useState(false);\n  const [followStatus, setFollowStatus] = useState\u003c'none' | 'pending' | 'following' | 'blocked'\u003e('none');\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const checkPermissions = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        const canSend = await MessagingService.canSendMessage(currentUserId, targetUserId);\n        setCanMessage(canSend);\n        \n        const status = await SocialService.getFollowStatus(currentUserId, targetUserId);\n        setFollowStatus(status);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error checking message permissions:', error);\n        setCanMessage(false);\n      }\n    };\n    \n    checkPermissions();\n  }, [currentUserId, targetUserId]);\n\n  const handleSendMessage = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!message.trim()) return;\n    \n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      \n      await MessagingService.sendDirectMessage(currentUserId, targetUserId, message.trim());\n      \n      setMessage('');\n      setIsOpen(false);\n      onMessageSent?.();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error sending message:', error);\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to send message');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const getButtonText = () =\u003e {\n    if (!canMessage) {\n      return 'Cannot Message';\n    }\n    \n    switch (followStatus) {\n      case 'following':\n        return 'Message';\n      case 'pending':\n        return 'Follow First';\n      default:\n        return 'Follow to Message';\n    }\n  };",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';\nimport { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';\nimport { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';\nimport { SocialProfile, PortfolioItem, SocialPost, SkillEndorsement } from '../../types/Social';\nimport './ProfileView.scss';\n\nconst ProfileView: React.FC = () =\u003e {\n  const { userId } = useParams\u003c{ userId: string }\u003e();\n  const { currentUser } = useAuth();\n  const [profile, setProfile] = useState\u003cSocialProfile | null\u003e(null);\n  const [posts, setPosts] = useState\u003cSocialPost[]\u003e([]);\n  const [endorsements, setEndorsements] = useState\u003cSkillEndorsement[]\u003e([]);\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState\u003c'posts' | 'portfolio' | 'skills' | 'connections'\u003e('posts');\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [isFollowing, setIsFollowing] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadProfileData();\n  }, [userId]);",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
```
